# Low Poly Brazil Props Kit (Kit Props Brasil Low Poly)

> Free, public domain (CC0 1.0) pack of light low poly 3D props in glTF/GLB with Brazilian scenery: nature
> (wildflowers, termite mound, mandacaru cactus, water lilies, water hyacinth), wildlife (capybara, egret, turtle,
> caramel street dog, cow), street (orelhão phone booth, market stall, popcorn cart, concrete pole), countryside
> (hay bale, farm gate, beehive, scarecrow), river (canoe, pier, fishing net), sustainable technology (solar street
> light, rain barrel, river buoy, rain gauge, water meter) and pollution signs (trash, floating plastic, river
> foam, sewage pipe, tires with stagnant water). Most props have 150 triangles or fewer; flat colors, no textures.
> Works in Godot, Unity (glTFast), Unreal Engine 5, three.js, Babylon.js and Blender. Commercial use allowed;
> attribution optional.

- Repository: https://github.com/kayquer/kit-props-brasil-lowpoly
- License: CC0 1.0 (public domain), see LICENSE
- Authors: Kayque Rotondo and Cláudia Dias Roxinol (see CITATION.cff)
- Format: binary glTF (.glb), Y up, front facing -Z, one PBR material per color (base color only)
- Scale: toy scale for a grid where 1 lot = 2 × 2 units (same as https://github.com/kayquer/kit-cidade-lowpoly)
- Land props stand on y = 0; water props sit on the water surface at y = 0
- Budget: ≤ 150 triangles per prop, except detalhados/ and arvores/ (≤ 1,500); every file < 150 KB
- Source: one Blender 4.5 Python script per model in `src/<category>/<id>.py`; shared helpers in `src/lib.py`
- File names are in Portuguese; English names below and in tools/nomes_en.json

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-props-brasil-lowpoly/blob/main/README.md): usage, catalog, FAQ
- [README (Português)](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-props-brasil-lowpoly/blob/main/README.pt-BR.md): mesma documentação em português
- [Model catalog JSON](https://github.com/kayquer/kit-props-brasil-lowpoly/blob/main/models/catalogo.json): id, category, triangles, KB, Portuguese description

## Models

<!-- catalogo:inicio -->
- Nature (Natureza): `models/natureza/aguape.glb` Floating water hyacinths with lilac flowers (grow in sewage-rich water); `models/natureza/arbustos.glb` Flowering shrubs; `models/natureza/capim_alto.glb` Tall grass tuft; `models/natureza/cupinzeiro.glb` Red-earth termite mound; `models/natureza/flores_campo.glb` Wildflowers; `models/natureza/mandacaru.glb` Mandacaru cactus with two arms; `models/natureza/matacao.glb` Large mossy boulder; `models/natureza/pedras.glb` Riverside rocks with grass tufts; `models/natureza/taboa.glb` Cattails for the water's edge; `models/natureza/toco.glb` Cut tree stump; `models/natureza/tronco_caido.glb` Fallen log with a mushroom; `models/natureza/vitoria_regia.glb` Giant water lilies (vitória-régia) with a pink flower, floating
- Wildlife and animals (Fauna): `models/fauna/cachorro_caramelo.glb` Caramel mutt dog lying down (Brazil's beloved street dog); `models/fauna/capivara.glb` Capybara; `models/fauna/garca.glb` White egret standing by the water; `models/fauna/tartaruga.glb` River turtle; `models/fauna/vaca.glb` Spotted pasture cow
- Street and neighborhood (Rua e bairro): `models/rua/banco_praca.glb` Park bench; `models/rua/barraca_feira.glb` Street market stall with a striped awning and fruit crates; `models/rua/bebedouro.glb` Public drinking fountain with a pet bowl; `models/rua/bicicletario.glb` Bike rack with a bicycle; `models/rua/bueiro.glb` Round storm drain / manhole; `models/rua/caixa_dagua.glb` Blue polyethylene water tank; `models/rua/carrinho_pipoca.glb` Popcorn cart with umbrella; `models/rua/cone_transito.glb` Traffic cone; `models/rua/hidrante.glb` Fire hydrant; `models/rua/lixeira_grade.glb` Raised wire trash basket on a post; `models/rua/mesa_cadeiras.glb` White plastic table and two chairs (no logos); `models/rua/orelhao.glb` Brazilian shell-shaped public phone booth (orelhão, no brand); `models/rua/placa_rua.glb` Blue street name sign (no letters); `models/rua/poste_concreto.glb` Concrete utility pole with a street light
- Countryside (Rural): `models/rural/caixotes.glb` Stacked wooden crates with fruit; `models/rural/cerca_mourao.glb` Wooden post and wire fence section; `models/rural/colmeia.glb` Beehive boxes on a stand; `models/rural/espantalho.glb` Scarecrow; `models/rural/fardo_feno.glb` Round hay bale; `models/rural/horta.glb` Raised vegetable bed; `models/rural/porteira.glb` Wooden farm gate
- River and riverside (Rio e beira d'água): `models/rio/canoa.glb` Wooden fishing canoe, floating; `models/rio/rede_pesca.glb` Fishing net drying between two stakes; `models/rio/trapiche.glb` Small wooden pier that juts forward over the water
- Sustainable technology (Tecnologia sustentável): `models/tecnologia/barril_chuva.glb` Rain barrel connected to a downspout; `models/tecnologia/boia_rio.glb` River monitoring buoy with a small solar panel; `models/tecnologia/hidrometro.glb` Water meter box; `models/tecnologia/lixeiras_coleta.glb` Simple recycling bins (blue, red, green); `models/tecnologia/placa_educativa.glb` Educational riverside sign (no letters); `models/tecnologia/pluviometro.glb` Rain gauge on a post; `models/tecnologia/poste_solar.glb` Solar street light
- Pollution signs (Sinais de poluição): `models/poluicao/entulho.glb` Construction rubble pile; `models/poluicao/espuma_rio.glb` Pollution foam floating on a river; `models/poluicao/lixo_flutuante.glb` Floating plastic bottles and bags; `models/poluicao/manilha_esgoto.glb` Concrete sewage pipe dumping dark water from a riverbank; `models/poluicao/monte_lixo.glb` Illegal trash dump pile; `models/poluicao/peixe_morto.glb` Dead fish floating belly-up (no gore); `models/poluicao/pneus_velhos.glb` Old tires holding stagnant water; `models/poluicao/saco_lixo.glb` Black trash bags; `models/poluicao/tambor_enferrujado.glb` Rusty leaking drum
- Detailed (up to 1,500 tris) (Detalhados (até 1.500 tris)): `models/detalhados/cisterna.glb` Rainwater cistern (Brazilian semi-arid) with hand pump and bucket; `models/detalhados/composteira.glb` Two-bay wooden compost bin with a shovel; `models/detalhados/lixeira_seletiva.glb` Four-bin recycling station on two posts; `models/detalhados/ponto_onibus.glb` Bus stop shelter with a green roof
- Native trees (up to 1,500 tris) (Árvores nativas (até 1.500 tris)): `models/arvores/araucaria.glb` Araucaria (Paraná pine) with layered flat crown and a pine cone; `models/arvores/buriti.glb` Buriti palm in a marshy patch, drooping fronds and coconut bunches; `models/arvores/ipe_amarelo.glb` Yellow ipê tree with an open blooming crown and fallen flowers
